description: A residential mortgage promissory note (fixed rate)

note_date.description: The date of the note, as YYYY-MM-DD

city.description: The city printed under the date line

state.description: The state printed under the date line

property_address.description: The property address, as one line

loan_number.description: The loan number; null if blacked out or illegible

principal_amount.description: Section 1: the principal amount borrowed, in USD

lender.description: Section 1: the lender's name, as printed

interest_rate_percent.description: Section 2: the yearly interest rate, as a percent number (3.875 for 3.875%)

first_payment_date.description: Section 3(A): the date monthly payments begin, as YYYY-MM-DD

payment_day_of_month.description: Section 3(A): the day of each month payments are due

maturity_date.description: Section 3(A): the maturity date, as YYYY-MM-DD

payment_address.description: Section 3(A): where payments are made, as one line

monthly_payment.description: Section 3(B): the monthly payment of principal and interest, in USD

late_charge_days.description: Section 6(A): the number of calendar days after the due date before a late charge applies

late_charge_percent.description: Section 6(A): the late charge, as a percent of the overdue payment

va_guaranteed.description: True if the note says the loan is guaranteed by, or subject to the regulations of, the Department of Veterans Affairs

assumable_without_approval.description: False if the note says the loan is not assumable without the approval of the Department of Veterans Affairs or its agent

form.description: The uniform instrument form named in the page footer, e.g. 'Multistate Fixed Rate Note - Single Family - Fannie Mae/Freddie Mac Uniform Instrument Form 3200 1/01'

borrower.description: The borrower who signed the note

name.description: The borrower's printed name under the signature line

is_signed.description: True if the borrower's signature line carries a signature

initialed_pages.description: The number of pages carrying the borrower's initials

loan_originator.description: The loan originator named under the signature
